lines.text: The apostles reported all they had done and taught, then went away with Jesus in a boat to a solitary place.
Crowds ran on foot from all the towns and arrived first, and Jesus had compassion on them and taught them.
When the hour was late, Jesus told the disciples to give the people food, and they found five loaves and three fish.
Jesus had the people sit in groups on the green grass, then blessed the loaves and fish and gave them to His disciples.
All ate and were satisfied, and the disciples gathered seven basketfuls of pieces, and five thousand men had eaten.
